observed_anchors.existing_v5_behavior: root-anchor/runtime/source/parent-child admission fails closed but the shell launcher previously described itself as the first trust boundary

grf.generated_reality: The V5 shell launcher can be the first execution trust boundary because it fixes PATH before invoking helpers and then delegates to the Python guard.
grf.counter_reality: The ELF dynamic loader can execute inherited loader-control content before /bin/sh executes the first shell statement, so shell-level checks cannot be the earliest execution boundary.
grf.hidden_assumption: No attacker-controlled dynamic-loader environment is processed before shell code begins.
grf.falsifier: Compare the same V5 launcher invocation without loader injection against one bounded run-owned LD_PRELOAD constructor sentinel on the accepted target.
grf.predicted_if_generated_reality_right: No constructor sentinel can execute before the V5 shell establishes its invariants.
grf.predicted_if_counter_reality_right: Treatment constructor executes in the shell process before V5 shell checks; baseline remains clean.

unusual_experiment.name: PRE_GUARD_PRELOAD_SENTINEL
unusual_experiment.safety_bounds: run-owned harmless constructor wrote only PID/executable observations under /tmp; no root changes, no Frank state, no effect authority; run-owned tree cleaned
unusual_experiment.interpretation: Downstream V5 SQLite admission still failed closed, but the claim that trust begins inside the shell was falsified.
unusual_experiment.repetition_policy: The experiment workflow was converted to workflow_dispatch-only after the single evidence run so follow-up commits do not silently repeat it.

changes: V5 launcher no longer claims the shell is the earliest trust boundary.
Non-empty LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT or LD_LIBRARY_PATH reaching the shell admission are rejected fail-closed.
Those variables are unset before accepted downstream helper execution.
The launcher explicitly requires an upstream trusted execution/environment boundary before /bin/sh is exec'd.
repair.important_limitation: Shell rejection is defense-in-depth only; it cannot retroactively prevent loader code that executed before the shell. Therefore this repair does not close F-V01-13.

fusion_with_parallel_evidence.parallel_delta: A sibling GO cycle promoted a distinct negative result showing ldd can diverge from the object already mapped in the observing process after loader-environment changes.
fusion_with_parallel_evidence.combined_mechanism: Release-safe SQLite admission requires at least two distinct boundaries: upstream execution/environment provenance before the shell, and exact live mapped-object plus release-accepted SQLite identity downstream. ldd-style fresh resolution is diagnostic and must not substitute for live mapped-object identity.
fusion_with_parallel_evidence.non_claim: Neither evidence item proves that the actual productive Frank service currently starts through a trusted parent or maps the fixed release-accepted SQLite object.
